scope: Current NI-01 offline reporting stage only. All 26 stories and R01-R38/T01-T38 remain mandatory; no milestone completion.

R01.evidence: Owner helper and report matrix compare synthetic matching, mismatched and absent claims only.
R01.required_live_evidence: Verify trusted physical Sextant identity and VM/engine binding; establish no inventory runtime on physical Phronesis or Contabo. Record dated, sanitized owner evidence.

R16.evidence: No DNS, TLS, listeners or access-control checks executed; offline route labels do not establish connectivity.
R16.required_live_evidence: Verify the approved private hostname over LAN and VPN, certificate trust and enrolled identity; prove guest, WAN and unauthorized IPv6 denial without metadata exposure.

R17.evidence: 20 production-bound bootstrap tests include all nine route pairs and 405 route/owner/service/source report combinations; explicit VPN-up/service-down and service-up/source-down checks passed.
R17.required_live_evidence: Exercise real home LAN with VPN off/on and away with VPN off/on; independently interrupt inventory service, source authentication and client connection in an authorized test window; retain distinct status and recovery evidence.

R18.evidence: No native discovery/helper implementation or live impostor rejection tested. Supplied identity comparison is not authentication.
R18.required_live_evidence: Observe native service advertisement, TLS and enrolled identity verification before authentication, impostor/rebinding rejection and network-change reconnect independent of the legacy resolver.

R19.evidence: No shared client configuration or external project accessed.
R19.required_live_evidence: Verify installed shared MCP configuration and use two fresh authorized non-Sysco project tasks to resolve an endpoint through the same inventory owner/tools, with source, freshness and vantage evidence.

R20.evidence: Synthetic privacy test passes: identities, credentials, HA state, resource contents, command arguments, description, URI, icon and unknown fields absent from report; stdout/stderr empty; input preserved. Only the offline return boundary is tested.
R20.required_live_evidence: Inject synthetic canaries through authorized source adapters; verify absence across storage, API, UI, SSE, cache and logs, including revocation; retain sanitized results without copying secrets.

R24.evidence: Repository-only verify-pericope-deploy-lock.sh passed (20 static checks); deployment files unchanged. No runtime lock/registry/graph reconciliation executed.
R24.required_live_evidence: Owner must record and preserve existing dirty worktrees before any work: branch, commit, status, untracked paths and hashes of dirty files in a private record; never auto-stash, clean or overwrite them. Read authoritative workspace policies and reconcile lock, registry, graph, immutable images, host identity, auth and smoke checks; verify protected Pericope contracts unchanged.

R26.evidence: Offline source inspection and privacy tests show supplied-evidence classification only; no network/control operations added. Operator checker checks prohibited imports.
R26.required_live_evidence: Instrument approved discovery paths to prove zero scanning, HA actuation, Docker writes, arbitrary SSH/URL/process execution, downstream MCP invocation or automatic DNS/VPN changes; verify deployment refusal cases.

T12.evidence: Synthetic hostile description/URI/icon/command fields are dropped by report; no output or input mutation. Rendering/fetch behavior elsewhere is untested.
T12.required_live_evidence: Test malicious metadata end-to-end with instrumented UI and adapters: inert escaped content, zero remote icon/URI fetches or launched processes.

T15.evidence: Report matrix independently maps service and source true/false/null; this utility has no authentication-error, reconciliation or client-disconnect model.
T15.required_live_evidence: Distinguish source auth failure, client disconnect and service failure; prove no mass offline/deletion and correct resnapshot/recovery.

T17.evidence: All nine supplied route combinations tested against preserved production helper; DNS/TLS untested.
T17.required_live_evidence: Run actual home/away and VPN off/on matrix; record route evidence plus private DNS/TLS results and native helper behavior.

T18.evidence: Explicit VPN-up/service-down test retains vpn route and unknown source; separate source-down test keeps service available. No first-visit browser test.
T18.required_live_evidence: With VPN up, make the inventory unavailable in an authorized isolated test; verify accurate helper messaging, including first visit without cached shell, and no false device-outage claims.

T19.evidence: Synthetic owner mismatch is covered but no Bonjour, authentication, TLS or rebinding implementation is exercised.
T19.required_live_evidence: Present an impostor advertisement and rebinding endpoint in an authorized harness; prove rejection before any credential transmission and reconnect only to enrolled identity.

T20.evidence: No fresh external project task or shared MCP registration executed.
T20.required_live_evidence: Run two fresh authorized non-Sysco project tasks using the same configured inventory MCP; record owner/tools and evidence-backed endpoint resolution.

T21.evidence: Synthetic canaries absent from offline report and stdout/stderr. Storage/API/SSE/cache/log paths are not implemented by this utility.
T21.required_live_evidence: Trace synthetic HA/Docker/MCP canaries through store, API, UI, SSE, cache and logs; confirm no sensitive contents, including after logout/revocation.

T24.evidence: No runtime or cold-start test performed.
T24.required_live_evidence: In an authorized test window cold-start with physical Phronesis unavailable and WAN interrupted; show independent graph/sources/bootstrap startup and explicitly unavailable cloud sources.

T26.evidence: Static Pericope contract check passed, but no inventory deployment verifier refusal exercised.
T26.required_live_evidence: In an isolated authorized acceptance harness, supply wrong host identity, occupied port and mismatched image/lock; capture verifier refusal before application, preserving existing services.

T27.evidence: No guest, WAN, IPv6 or access-scoped graph test performed.
T27.required_live_evidence: From authorized negative-test vantages verify guest/WAN/unauthorized IPv6 cannot obtain private graph, metadata, source credentials or cached/event data.
